title: Tin Trong, the Little Bus
summary: Tin Trong the little bus travels a long road every day, up and down the hills, in sunshine, dust and mud. One day Tin Trong gets sick. How will he get better and carry his passengers again?
pages: There is a little bus named Tin Trong. He travels a long road every day!
Tin Trong goes up the hill and down the hill. He drives in the sun and in the rain, in the dust and in the mud.
One day Tin Trong is very tired. He gets back to his parking spot late.

Tin Trong coughs. Ahoo, ahoo, ahhh, ahhh!
He is too sick to drive tomorrow.

The next day Tin Trong calls in sick. He knows what will help him feel better. He needs rest and good care at the garage! Creak creak! Chick chick!
Tap tap! Tap tap!
Creak creak! Chick chick! Tap tap! Tap tap! Now Tin Trong feels better. In fact, he feels great!
Tin Trong asks for one more thing. He asks for a shower. Then he goes for a nap. Tomorrow he has to get up early!
The next day Tin Trong is strong again. He drives straight ahead. He drives back and forth, left and right.
Tin tin... tat tat... tin tin... Tin Trong takes his passengers home, one by one. They are happy. "We missed you yesterday," they say. "But everybody needs a rest sometimes!"
